targets.query: from(bucket: "aqi") |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop) |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "pmsa003i_pm25_standard" and r._field == "data") |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: mean) |> yield(name: "pm2.5")
